name: Aspen rate-law form for Kum Temkin-Pyzhev
value: GENERAL POWERLAW, reversible, REV-METH=AUTOMATIC; r_rxn = k pNH3^0.54 pH2^-0.81 (1 - pN2 pH2^3/(pNH3^2 Keq2)) per 2 mol NH3
source: algebraic identity with kum2026heatintegrated Eq. 2 (p. 4); Aspen V15 example 'Ammonia decomposition datafit' for the input language
applicability_note: Exact identity of the published law if Keq^2 is the equilibrium constant of 2NH3 = N2 + 3H2 (the AmCraX reading recorded in kinetics.yaml).

name: PRE-EXP
source: kum2026heatintegrated Table 1 ko = 55245.9 mol g^-1 s^-1 bar^0.27, x1000 g/kg /1000 mol/kmol /2 (per reaction event)
applicability_note: Rate per kg catalyst; partial pressures in bar (PRES-UNIT=BAR).

name: ACT-ENERGY
applicability_note: No reference temperature (k = k0 exp(-E/RT)) as in the source.

name: Equilibrium constant in Aspen
value: from Gibbs energies of the property method (PENG-ROB databank, ideal-gas reference)
source: Aspen micro-reversibility option; Kum Eq. 4 polynomial (T^3 term) has no exact native form
applicability_note: Python comparison uses keq_basis='amcrax_thermo' (NASA7/GRI-Mech 3.0) for the same reason; Kum Eq. 4 differs from Gibbs data by < 0.5 kJ/mol per kinetics.yaml.

name: H2 seed
unit: fraction of feed NH3 pre-cracked to N2/H2 before the reactor
source: numerical: rate singular at pH2 = 0. Seed 1e-6 caused 'BLOCK IS IN MASS IMBALANCE' in adiabatic and coolant RPLUG runs, 1e-4 still in the coolant run; 1e-3 solved all modes
applicability_note: Python PFR (same seeded feed) outlet conversion changes by < 3e-5 between seeds 1e-6 and 1e-3 (coolant case 0.17340 vs 0.17342). Conversions are reported relative to the reactor-inlet NH3 and to the fresh NH3.

name: Bed and particle data
value: eps_b 0.36, particle density 980 kg/m3, dp 0.6 mm, tube ID 0.126 m
applicability_note: Catalyst mass = (1-eps_b) x particle density x bed volume, in both Aspen (CAT-RHO, BED-VOIDAGE) and Python.

name: Validation geometry
value: 50 tubes of 0.126 m ID, 20 kg catalyst (0.051 m bed), 100 kmol/h feed
source: test conditions chosen to give 16-76 % conversion (kinetic regime); not a design
applicability_note: Infrastructure verification only; 450-500 degC points up to the 723 K fit limit, 500 degC is above it (773 K).

name: Integrated RPLUG pressure
value: no pressure drop unless pressure_drop=true; CRACKER outlet at HEATER outlet pressure (P + 0.2 bar)
source: RGibbs CRACKER sets outlet P exactly; RPLUG keeps inlet P without a drop model
applicability_note: Downstream COOLER/PSA pressures are absolute in the flowsheet and unchanged.

name: Phase
applicability_note: Adiabatic runs still report the warning 'PROBLEM(S) ENCOUNTERED DURING PHASE STABILITY CHECK'.

name: Catalyst operating temperature (part 2)
value: lowest T giving X = 0.95 with 100 kg catalyst per 100 kmol/h NH3 at 20 bar, isothermal; rounded up to 1 degC
source: definition of this study; T from results/research/kinetics/study_temperature_for_target_conversion.json
applicability_note: 99 % at 20 bar is equilibrium-limited below about 685 degC for every catalyst, so a 99 % target would not discriminate between catalysts.

name: Takahashi Ni/MgO and Ru/MgO in Aspen
value: fitted LHHW approximation (best_native_approximation), mole-fraction basis, used only at 20 bar
source: results/research/kinetics/aspen_kinetics_spec.json (kinetics workstream fit to the microkinetic law)
applicability_note: Not the published law; rate error RMS 12 %, max about 50 %. Integrated cases run the cracker at 20.2 bar (heater outlet), 1 % above the pressure in the fitted term-2 constant.

name: H2 seed in isothermal catalyst runs
value: 1e-6 of the NH3 pre-cracked (1e-3 in adiabatic runs, 1e-4 kmol/h-scale H2SEED stream in integrated runs)
source: numerical requirement (Kum rate singular at pH2 = 0); part 1 tests
applicability_note: Python comparison uses the same seeded feed.

name: GHSV reference state
value: NH3 feed volume at 0 degC, 1 atm (22.414 m3/kmol) over the bed volume
applicability_note: Bed volume = W/((1-eps) rho_p) with the bed properties of aspen_kinetics_spec.json.

name: Adiabatic catalyst runs without pressure drop
value: inlet 650 degC, 20 bar, 100 kg, no Ergun
applicability_note: The Lucentini particle size (0.1 mm lab powder) would give an unrealistic Ergun pressure drop.

name: Effectiveness factor
source: powder kinetics applied directly to the bed
applicability_note: Industrial pellets would need an effectiveness factor below 1; catalyst masses are lower bounds.
